topic: Ordering Dinner with a Nut Allergy

script.title: DINING WITH A NUT ALLERGY
script.story_hook: Dinner turns serious when a nut allergy surfaces.
script.intro_zh: 一頓晚餐因為堅果過敏變得認真起來。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today a diner talks about a nut allergy.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎大家回來！今天的情境是一場關於堅果過敏的晚餐點餐。
script.outro: Safe dining starts with good English. Practice tonight!
script.outro_zh: 安心用餐從好的英文開始。今晚就練習一次吧！
script.practice_intro_en: Time to speak up. Repeat every line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 該開口了，跟著我一句一句唸。

Got a food allergy and no idea how to say it in English? This 18-line restaurant scene covers it all: telling your waiter, double-checking sauces and pans, and even screening dessert. Real American English with IPA transcription and Traditional Chinese meaning, plus a repeat-after-me section. Listen once, speak with confidence tonight.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥗餐廳英文｜告知過敏・確認食材・篩選甜點｜聽完就會點餐｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
對堅果過敏，在國外餐廳該從何開口？
醬料裡有沒有堅果？鍋子會不會共用？

這一集帶大家走進一家溫暖熱鬧的晚餐餐廳，跟著顧客從告知過敏、詢問主廚，到確認甜點，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🥜 告知過敏：例如「I have a nut allergy.」、「even a little crumb makes me sick.」
🍳 確認料理：例如「Is the pan shared with nut dishes?」、「let me double-check with the chef.」
🍰 甜點把關：例如「The chocolate cake has hazelnut layers.」、「Is that safe?」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

平安吃飽一頓飯，也能靠英文辦到！
script.thumbnail_action: showing an epinephrine pen packet to the waiter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a nut allergy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi aɪ hæv ə nʌt ˈælərdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我對堅果過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for letting me know. Peanuts, or all nuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ˈlɛtɪŋ mi noʊ ˈpinəts ɔr ɔl nʌts/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。是花生，還是所有堅果？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All nuts, even a little crumb makes me sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl nʌts ˈivn ə ˈlɪtəl kræm meɪks mi sɪk/
dialogue.zh: 全部堅果，哪怕一點碎屑都會讓我不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Do you have an epipen with you tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt du ju hæv ən ˈɛpəˌpɛn wɪð ju təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。你今晚帶有腎上腺素筆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's in my bag. Better to be safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪts ɪn maɪ bæɡ ˈbɛtər tə bi seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 有，在我包裡。小心總比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. The mushroom risotto has almond crumbs on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt ðə ˈmʌʃrʊm roʊˈzɑtoʊ hæz ˈɑmənd krɑmz ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。蘑菇燉飯上面撒了杏仁碎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I didn't know that. What would you suggest?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ ˈdɪdənt noʊ ðæt wʌt wʊd ju sədʒɛst/
dialogue.zh: 啊，我不知道。你會推薦什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The grilled salmon comes with a citrus butter sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrɪld ˈsæmən kʌmwɪð ə ˈsɪtrəs ˈbʌtər sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 烤鮭魚附的是柑橘奶油醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds good. Is the pan shared with nut dishes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ɡʊd ɪz ðə pæn ʃɛrd wɪð nʌt ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯。平底鍋有沒有跟堅果料理共用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great question, let me double-check with the chef.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ˈkwɛstʃən lɛt mi ˈdʌbəlˌtʃɛk wɪð ðə ʃɛf/
dialogue.zh: 好問題，讓我再去跟主廚確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time. I really don't want to risk it.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm aɪ ˈrɪli doʊnt wɑnt tə rɪsk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不急。我真的不想冒這個險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back with news: fresh clean pan, totally safe for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk wɪð nuz frɛʃ klin pæn ˈtoʊtli seɪf fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 有好消息：用乾淨的新鍋煎，對你完全安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much. Can I also ask about dessert?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju su mʌtʃ kæn aɪ ˈɔlsə æsk əˈbaʊt dɪˈzərt/
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了。可以順便問甜點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chocolate cake has hazelnut layers, I'm afraid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɑklət keɪk hæz ˈhæzənˌʌt ˈleɪərz aɪm əˈfreɪd/
dialogue.zh: 恐怕巧克力蛋糕裡夾了榛果層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better skip it then. Fruit, maybe? Is that safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər skɪp ɪt ðɛn frut ˈmeɪbi ɪz ðæt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那還是跳過吧。水果呢？那個安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. I'll bring a berry plate with the salmon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli aɪl brɪŋ ə ˈbɛri pleɪt wɪð ðə ˈsæmən/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。我會連鮭魚一起端上漿果盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been so helpful. Thanks for checking everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /jubɪn su ˈhɛlpfl θæŋks fər ˈtʃɛkɪŋ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你幫了大忙，謝謝你確認所有細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Enjoy your dinner, allergy-free tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒər ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔr ˈdɪnər ˌælərˈdʒi fri təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。請慢慢享用，今晚零過敏。
